_comment: Copy to configs/<slug>.json. One entry per competitor; leave out a site the competitor isn't on. g2 = the slug in g2.com/products/<slug>, capterra = '<id>/<Name>' from capterra.com/p/<id>/<Name>/, trustradius = the slug in trustradius.com/products/<slug>, trustpilot = the domain in trustpilot.com/review/<domain>. buyer_hint (optional) tells the LLM who counts as a buyer on Trustpilot, which has no job titles.
buyer_hint: Our buyers are recruiters, HR and talent acquisition leads, and owners who post jobs.
